literal_meaning: বায়ুতে পাতলা দ্রব্যের দ্রুত সঞ্চালনের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ
figurative_meaning_bn: বায়ুতে পাতলা দ্রব্যের দ্রুত সঞ্চালনের শব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: The sound of rapid movement of thin objects in the wind
example_sentences_in_english: The kite is flying in the sky making a whirring sound.
The leaves are fluttering in the wind.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to mimic sounds of swift aerial movement.
